option.wenhan-client.creative-flying.ena: Enables flight in Survival and Adventure mode.
option.wenhan-client.double-jump.jump_co: Sets the total number of jumps available before landing.
option.wenhan-client.double-jump.coyote_: Allows a ground jump for this many ticks after walking or falling off an edge.
option.wenhan-client.double-jump.cooldow: Requires the configured number of ticks between additional airborne jumps.
option.wenhan-client.flight-disabler.ena: Disables creative flight and elytra fall flying.
option.wenhan-client.elytra-cancel.enabl: Press jump while elytra gliding to stop fall flying.
option.wenhan-client.no-flight-reset.ena: Keeps creative flight enabled when touching the ground.
option.wenhan-client.no-jump-delay.enabl: Removes the jump cooldown so holding jump can trigger consecutive jumps immediately.
option.wenhan-client.no-collision.enable: Prevents other entities from pushing the local player.
option.wenhan-client.attack-through-foli: Allows entity targeting through non-colliding blocks such as grass and flowers.
option.wenhan-client.no-slowdown.enabled: Removes movement slowdown while using shields, bows, crossbows, tridents, spyglasses, goat horns, food, and drink items.
option.wenhan-client.no-slime-bounce.ena: Prevents slime blocks from bouncing the local player.
option.wenhan-client.no-fog.enabled.tool: Removes water, lava, powdered snow, blindness, darkness, weather, boss, dimension terrain fog, and FOV distortion.
Keeps barrier, structure void, and light blocks visible.
option.wenhan-client.who-i-am.show_local: Shows your own player name tag in third-person or free-camera views.
option.wenhan-client.who-i-am.append_pla: Adds your player name to the Minecraft window title.
When the current minecart turns, applies the same change to the player view.
option.wenhan-client.better-step.air_ste: Allows player step-up handling while airborne when colliding with small ledges.
option.wenhan-client.better-step.step_do: Allows smooth controlled step-down when moving toward reachable lower ground.
option.wenhan-client.better-step.sneakin: Sets the step height used while sneaking.
command.wenhan-client.ghostblock.no_play: Ghostblock failed: player is not ready.
option.wenhan-client.hide-realms.enabled: Disables Realms background checks and hides the Minecraft Realms button on the title screen.
When disabled, the effective maximum multiplier is limited to 20.00x. When enabled, the effective maximum is 100.00x.
Saved upper bound for the temporary flight speed multiplier.
Lower bound for the temporary flight speed multiplier.
Saved multiplier used for the first adjustment and for reset-on-adjust.
When enabled, pressing the adjustment key resets the multiplier to the configured default value. When disabled, the previous multiplier is preserved.
Controls how many non-linear multiplier adjustment operations are applied per mouse-wheel unit.
Also applies the current multiplier to client-controlled movement.
option.wenhan-client.hide-password.enabl: Masks password arguments while typing supported login and account commands.
option.wenhan-client.hide-password.hide_: When enabled, masked password arguments render as a fixed eight-character mask.
option.wenhan-client.interaction-delay.m: While holding attack on blocks, lowers repeat mining delay to 1 tick.
option.wenhan-client.interaction-delay.p: While holding use on blocks, lowers repeat use/place delay to 1 tick.
Enables player highlighting and its information HUD.
Keeps player highlighting enabled without holding the highlight key.
Shows nearby players and waypoint information on the HUD.
option.wenhan-client.no-texture-rotation: Disables position-based random block model variants such as random texture rotation.
Removes random visual position offsets from blocks such as grass and bamboo.
Keeps visual offsets for blocks with a non-empty collision shape.
option.wenhan-client.boat-utils.unrestri: Removes the vanilla 180-degree yaw restriction, allowing the camera to rotate freely in a full circle.
option.wenhan-client.boat-utils.view_dir: Makes the boat follow the view direction. Left and right movement keys strafe horizontally instead of turning the boat.
option.wenhan-client.boat-utils.directio: Enables the four boat direction shortcuts. Up snaps to the nearest allowed direction, Down turns around, and Left or Right turns to the next allowed direction on that side.
When enabled, allowed directions are every multiple of 45 degrees. When disabled, only the four cardinal directions are allowed.
option.wenhan-client.boat-utils.blue_ice: Makes the boat use blue ice friction at all times.
option.wenhan-client.boat-utils.prevent_: While the boat is underwater, sets an upward speed to prevent it from sinking.
option.wenhan-client.boat-utils.boat_ste: Sets the maximum height the boat can step up while moving. Range: 0.0 to 10.0 blocks.
option.wenhan-client.boat-utils.handbrak: While controlling a boat, holding the jump key applies the handbrake.
If enabled, after releasing the handbrake, adds a boost based on how long the handbrake was held.
option.wenhan-client.boat-utils.lateral_: Applies additional friction to lateral boat movement.
